scientific_integrity: Transfer-matrix, cyclic Green-function, and rank-one inverse arguments are supplied in full. Exact arithmetic and independent enumeration checked 6605 cases/assertions, but the proof rather than finite data supplies unrestricted quantifiers. An earlier implicit Potts-model inversion may exist.
scientific_limitations: Uniform proper colorings of a fixed simple cycle and inverse covariance of one marked-color indicator only; precision statements concern linear partial correlation, not conditional independence. The three-color triangle is singular. No weighted-color or general-graph theorem is claimed.
title: Parity-controlled nonlocal precision in uniformly colored cycles
